title: untrusted_stripped
description: callum-flow-issue-read dropped or refused content by an untrusted author. Records the count, never the content. Housekeeping; written on every such read, so it repeats. Written by: callum-flow-issue-read, under whichever tool read (queue-watch, claim, sweep, factory-state, routes, merge-guard, the loop). Applied after the envelope by event.schema.json.

issue.description: The issue read; on a PR read the PR number (issue and pr are then the same number).

pr.description: The PR, on a PR read.

note.description: For people: what was read: issue, pr, comment, comments=<n>, list stripped=<n> or timeline=<n>. No reader parses it.
